heading: Wednesday, July 9, 2025
topLine: xAI releases Grok 4 and Grok 4 Heavy.

items.headline: xAI releases Grok 4 and Grok 4 Heavy
items.summary: Grok 4 is xAI's flagship reasoning model with native tool use and real-time search, offered with a 256k-token context in the API; Grok 4 Heavy uses parallel test-time compute and is sold through a new SuperGrok Heavy tier. xAI reports Grok 4 Heavy as the first model to reach 50% on Humanity's Last Exam (text-only subset) and Grok 4 at 15.9% on ARC-AGI-2.
